messages:
sam (eng-sec): Quick check — SOC2 fieldwork is scheduled two weeks out. Need a short owners list for KMS/HSM evidence, audit-log ingest, and dev/staging access matrix. Anyone owning these pieces?

jordan (infra): I can own audit-log ingest. Current blocker: staging vs prod parity for KMS events. Working on log-router config (rls->kafka->s3) to normalize fields; ETA Thu.

maria (devex): I can help with access matrix + example roles. Will draft a template and PR it by EOD tomorrow.

levi (eng-ops): HSM attestation/ceremony notes need ops sign-off. @sam can you confirm which vendor artifacts we must include? I have a partial vendor report but not the signed attestation.

sam (eng-sec): For fieldwork we need vendor-signed attestation, key ceremony minutes, and evidence that envelope keys rotate monthly (or a documented rotation window). Also a mapping of who has HSM operator access.

anya (audit): FYI audit team expects: rotation policy doc, recent rotation event proof, last access review for HSM operators, and a small audit-log sample showing KMS Encrypt/Decrypt/Rotate events. A short query + 100-line sample is fine.

jordan (infra): I can produce the sample. Example log snippet: ```json
{"time":"2026-04-12T14:22:03Z","event":"Encrypt","key_id":"env-1234","principal":"svc-llm","status":"success"}
``` I'll drop a sanitized sample into the evidence bucket and include a query used to extract it.

maria (devex): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/424 — access-matrix template + permissions checklist. Ping me if you want fields changed.

levi (eng-ops): Small snag: vendor HSM console doesn't expose a "monthly-rotation" flag via API. We have to stitch rotation proof from ceremony minutes + KMS key metadata. I'll attach minutes and a timeline.

sam (eng-sec): That works — include ceremony minutes and vendor signature. Also let's make a concise owner:artifact:due list now so audit has clear ARs.

anya (audit): I'll be the audit liaison. Suggested owner list: jordan:audit-log-sample:2026-04-18; maria:access-matrix:2026-04-14; levi:hsm-attestation+ceremony-minutes:2026-04-20; sam:control-mapping+evidence-bucket-manifest:2026-04-15.

jordan (infra): Confirmed for audit-log-sample by 2026-04-18. I'll upload to s3://redwood-evidence/kms-samples and DM the link when done.

maria (devex): I'll open the PR today and request reviews from @sam and @anya — should be quick.

levi (eng-ops): I'll gather ceremony minutes and the vendor attestation this week. Possible delay if vendor ticketing SLA isn't met — filing support ticket now.

sre-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-04-13T02:00Z — logging flags for KMS events enabled. Reaction :white_check_mark: 

sam (eng-sec): Two more asks: 1) include a sha256 checksum for each artifact in the evidence bucket (manifest.json with checksums). 2) redact any PII in the log samples and include a mapping doc stored in the vault.

jordan (infra): Will add checksums and a manifest.json. Sample upload path + manifest will be in the s3 object metadata and a signed link shared.

anya (audit): If owners hit blockers, call out here ASAP. I can escalate to the audit team to shift fieldwork by +3 days, but prefer to stay on schedule.

maria (devex): Quick question — do we need redacted PII examples or can we provide tokenized IDs only?

sam (eng-sec): Tokenized IDs only in samples. Mapping doc (cleartext) goes to the secure vault and is not in the evidence bucket.

levi (eng-ops): Noted. I'll scrub PII, upload sanitized logs, and put mapping doc in KMS-protected secret (vault path: secret/data/compliance/kms-mapping).

sam (eng-sec): Great. I'll assemble a short owner:artifact:link tracker and post in this thread tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

jordan (infra): One more technical detail — when I extract logs I'll normalize key_id to `env-<short>` and include original key_fingerprint in the manifest to prove linkage.

maria (devex): Thanks. I'll add a checklist item to the PR for manifest + fingerprint field.

anya (audit): Sounds good. If anyone wants me to join a quick 15-min sync to unblock vendor docs, I can do that Tue afternoon.

sam (eng-sec): If needed, let's schedule Tue 3pm. For now we keep async. Thanks everyone.
